title: Is It Easy to Be Young?
creator: Juris Podnieks
description: Juris Podnieks’s documentary about young Latvians in the 1980s: punks, a soldier back from Afghanistan, and students who did not believe in the Soviet future. It was seen by millions across the USSR. In Latvian and Russian.

title: Defenders of Riga
creator: Aigars Grauba
description: A big-budget drama about the defense of Riga in November 1919, when a German-Russian army attacked the new Latvian state from across the Daugava. In Latvian.

title: Homo Novus
creator: Anna Viduleja
description: A young painter arrives in Riga in the 1930s and falls in with the city’s bohemian artists. Based on a classic Latvian novel by Anšlavs Eglītis. In Latvian.

title: The Chronicles of Melanie
creator: Viesturs Kairišs
description: Based on the life of Melānija Vanaga, deported with her son from Riga to Siberia in June 1941, along with thousands of others. Trains left from Torņakalns station, where a memorial now stands. In Latvian.

title: Blizzard of Souls
creator: Dzintars Dreibergs
description: A teenage boy joins the Latvian Riflemen, Latvian units of the Russian army in the First World War, after his mother is killed. Based on a novel by Aleksandrs Grīns, a veteran. One of Latvia’s biggest box-office hits. In Latvian.
